notes.no_pass_cutoff: score >= this is NO_PASS. Lowest stressed-val defect score for iter1 (results/round1/summary.md), set without test.
notes.review_from: score in [review_from, no_pass_cutoff) goes to REVIEW: about 2x the highest clean-val good-vial score (0.055), a buffer for real-camera shift. Set on val only.
notes.fixture_map: golden-fixture position centres; each scene is shifted onto it by phase correlation against config/golden/scene.png (max 1 px error on the 50 test scenes)
